parameters.name: interface name
parameters.explanation: The name of the interface to configure the PPPoE client service on

parameters.name: client name

set access profile default authenticatio.command: set access profile default authentication-order chap

parameters.name: authentication method
parameters.explanation: Authentication method to be used (e.g., chap)

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family [parameter2] network [parameter3]

parameters.name: pool name
parameters.explanation: The name of the address assignment pool.

parameters.name: address family
parameters.explanation: The address family (e.g., inet for IPv4).

parameters.name: network address with subnet mask
parameters.explanation: The network address and subnet mask in CIDR notation.

set access address-assignment pool pool1.template: set access address-assignment pool [parameter1] family inet host-routing
